content.text: {"class": "PRODUCT_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The contract (billing-api v1 §4.2) states line items must not be rounded before summation and the total must be rounded HALF_UP exactly once; the logs show Money.of() rounding 50.005→50.00 and 49.995→49.99 individually, yielding 99.99 instead of the single-rounded 100.00. That is an independent statement of correct behaviour contradicted by a 2xx response, which is the PRODUCT_DEFECT shape, and test history confirms the test was untouched since its last green while billing-service commit 4e8bb07 'centralise rounding in Money.of()' landed in between. No release note documents the change as deliberate, so the staleness exception to TEST_CODE_DEFECT does not apply."}
